what_it_is.prose: Elbit Systems Limited (NASDAQ/TASE: ESLT) is an Israeli-listed defence OEM headquartered in Haifa. Elbit's India footprint is primarily through the Adani-Elbit joint venture — the Adani Elbit UAV Complex in Hyderabad (50,000 sq ft, inaugurated 2018-19), which is the first private UAV manufacturing facility in India and the first Hermes 900 production facility outside Israel. The Indian Navy received its first India-made UAV, the Drishti 10 Starliner (Indian designation for the Hermes 900 StarLiner), in January 2024. The facility has also produced 20+ Hermes 900 UAVs delivered to Israel from India. Elbit was awarded a $120 million international contract for Hermes 900 in September 2025. However, the Indian Navy has experienced two Hermes 900 crashes in 18 months — the first in January 2025 and the second in July 2026 (per CalcalistTech) — raising reliability concerns. IMPORTANT Atlas correction: The Atlas register attributes 'D-29 EW for Tejas' to Elbit, but D-29 is actually DRDO/DARE's indigenous electronic warfare suite, modernized as 'Swayam-Raksha-Kavach' (per The Week, November 2025). Elisra (an Elbit subsidiary) was reportedly approached for the D-29 in 2018 (per DefenseMirror), but the modernized D-29 is DRDO's own work — see REGISTER_TICKETS.md ticket P1-D29-EW-ATTRIBUTION.

faq.question: What is the Adani-Elbit joint venture?
faq.answer: The Adani-Elbit joint venture operates the Adani Elbit UAV Complex in Hyderabad (50,000 sq ft, inaugurated 2018-19) — the first private UAV manufacturing facility in India and the first Hermes 900 production facility outside Israel. The JV manufactures the Hermes 900 (designated Drishti 10 Starliner in Indian Navy service) for both Indian customers and export. The Indian Navy received its first India-made UAV from this facility in January 2024.

faq.question: Did Elbit make the D-29 EW suite for the Tejas?
faq.answer: No. The Atlas register's attribution of 'D-29 EW for Tejas' to Elbit appears to be incorrect. D-29 is DRDO/DARE's indigenous electronic warfare suite, modernized as 'Swayam-Raksha-Kavach' (per The Week, November 2025). Elisra (an Elbit subsidiary) was reportedly approached for the D-29 in 2018 (per DefenseMirror), but the modernized D-29 is DRDO's own work — see REGISTER_TICKETS.md ticket P1-D29-EW-ATTRIBUTION. This is flagged as an open question for Atlas register correction.

faq.question: What are the Hermes 900 reliability concerns in Indian Navy service?
faq.answer: Two Indian Navy Hermes 900 (Drishti 10 Starliner) UAVs have crashed within 18 months — the first in January 2025 and the second in July 2026 (per CalcalistTech). The Indian Navy is investigating the crashes. Despite these incidents, the Adani-Elbit JV continues to manufacture the Hermes 900, and Elbit was awarded a $120 million international Hermes 900 contract in September 2025.
